name: Delegate account: using a delegated account
description: Shows people with delegated access where to find their accounts in the user menu.

steps.title: You have access to other accounts
steps.content:
You have been given access to delegated accounts, which let you work in another person's account.

Select your user menu now to continue.

steps.title: Delegated accounts
steps.content: Select Delegated accounts to continue. It opens the list of accounts you may use.

steps.title: Open a delegated account
steps.content:
Select the name of the account you want to use. Moodle then opens that account.

Everything you do while using it is recorded in the site log under both your name and the name of the account. To stop working as that account, log out.
